15.t: Working with data: diffusion in agar
q: Which cube lost its colour fastest?
Calculate the mean for the 1.0 cm cube.
Identify the anomaly and calculate the mean for the 2.0 cm cube.
400 s is anomalous. Mean of 720 and 750 = 735 s.
Explain why doubling the cube size does far more than double the time.
The acid must diffuse further to reach the centre, and the volume grows faster than the surface area, so diffusion takes much longer.
